# Even when the in-script save was issued with ID 2 selected, the durable
# inventory is ID 1's. A new peer has fresh private state.
interest radius 1
expect inventory 0 Glass 3
expect items 1
expect item 1 Dirt 2
player create
expect inventory 0 empty 0
interest radius 2
flight on
teleport 520.5 225 8.5
wait 3
expect voxel 8 220 8 air
expect voxel 528 250 16 Glass
expect item 1 Dirt 2
give Dirt 1
drop 1
expect items 2
expect item 2 Dirt 1
